tagline: Planned: one verifier that gathers the checks of a design and says what is confirmed and what is inconclusive.
description: EH3D-DESIGN-VERIFIER is planned as an engineering verifier with cross-checks and quality control of the design. Today it has the base of every repository of the suite and a written scope, requirements and dependencies; no code has been written and nothing has been run on a machine.
